lines.text: The LORD tells Moses that Aaron must set up the seven lamps, and the lampstand is made of hammered gold.
The LORD tells Moses to cleanse the Levites with purification water, and they take a young bull with a grain offering.
Moses brings the Levites before the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron presents them as a wave offering so they can do the LORD's service.
The LORD took the Levites in place of Israel's firstborn, whom He set apart the day He parted the Red Sea.

wrong_details.true: I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt

lines.text: A Levite man starts the work at the Tent of Meeting at age thirty and retires from it at fifty.
